svg.text: Shapes, angles, measurements and geometric properties.

text.tspan: A point marks an exact position
and has no size at all.

g.text: Points are named with capital letters

text.tspan: A line is straight and endless

g.text: Exactly one line passes through 2 points

text.tspan: The part of a line between
two endpoints. It has a length.

g.text: A ray has one end and no other
The three angles always add to 180°
Angle sum grows with the side count

text.tspan: All points at the same distance

g.text: The distance r is the radius

text.tspan: How much surface a flat figure
How much space a solid takes

g.text: One fits exactly on top of the other

text.tspan: All sides scale by one factor.

g.text: A regular pentagon has 5 such axes
